newsitem.title: UK: Carlson in agreed bid for Inspirations.
newsitem.headline: Carlson in agreed bid for Inspirations.

text.p: Carlson Leisure Group (UK) Limited, the UK arm of Minneapolis-based Carlson Hospitality Group, has agreed to acquire British package holiday company Inspirations Plc for 42 million pounds ($70.4 million), the companies said on Thursday.
Carlson has also agreed to buy British Airways' entire stake in Inspirations for 5.5 million pounds.
Carlson in agreed bid for Inspirations
The offer for each ordinary share is 75p in cash, a premium of 22 percent to the closing price on Wednesday. The offer for convertible shares is 100p, a premium of 19.8 percent on Wednesday's close.
Carlson said the offer had the support of Inspirations shareholders representing 63.3 percent of the ordinary stock and 44.2 percent of convertible shares.
Inspirations said it made a pre-tax loss of 11.7 million pounds in the six months to March 31, on turnover of 125.9 million.
Inspirations owns 97 travel agencies operating under the AT Mays brand. These are managed by a Carlson Leisure subsidiary on behalf of Inspirations. ($ = 0.596 British Pounds)
